proof:resource-concurrency: Known red, kept out of CI until repaired (eco-6hoxj.163.23). Red since d749a43 (bound first-boot capture work) moved capture discovery to fs.opendirSync: the resource proof's directory observer wraps only fs.readdirSync, so it counts 0 entries and this proof's 2,000-entry floor fails. Counting opendirSync entries lets the observer see 497, but it changes the no_change_constant_work receipt that the system-e2e support contract pins, and wall-clock-bounded discovery makes those counts timing-dependent on CI. That contract change is a follow-up; wire this proof with it.
proof:session-sync-liveness: Machine-dependent timing guard. The proof refuses to run unless syncing its 1M-row session takes over 1.5 s. On Studio3 it takes 0.52 s (3M rows: 1.45 s), and the macos-14 runner runs SQLite-heavy proofs only about 2.2x slower, so the default fixture would fail its own guard in CI. Run it locally with SESSION_SYNC_LIVENESS_ROWS sized for the host (4000000 on Studio3: 1.93 s sync, 14 ms health ping, pass). eco-6hoxj.163.23
proof:session-sync-upgrade: Needs a v0.7.4 checkout (PLIMSOLL_V074_ROOT, default ../plimsoll-v074) and the private plimsoll-cloud source (PLIMSOLL_CLOUD_ROOT, default ../plimsoll-cloud: src/lib/delivery-ack.ts and src/lib/delivery-ack-response.ts), which the public CI checkout cannot fetch. The rule it proves (skippedStale counts every submitted row, eco-6hoxj.163.15) also runs in CI as proof:delivery partial_acknowledgement_counts_rejected_rows_as_skipped_stale.
